subject: NimbusCloud marketplace listing: usage-based SKU + metering integration
messages:
From: Sanjay Kumar <sanjay@nimbuscloud.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morozova <elena@nimbuscloud.io>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood marketplace listing — usage-based SKU & integration checklist

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick call last week. We're on a tight timeline to get NimbusCloud onto AWS Marketplace and hit an integration snag I wanted to surface early so we don't miss the target. Two things: 

1) Marketplace expects fixed-price SKUs for the public listing, but Nimbus is primarily usage-based (metered billing). The Marketplace team suggested converting to a "usage-exempt" SKU + metering off-band, but that requires a partner-side metering webhook and confirmation of metering design from Redwood. Do you have a standard approach for metered partners or any precedent for an exception?

2) Technical integration: we need a secure endpoint (POST /metering-events) that accepts metering events and returns 200/400, with JWT or mutual-TLS auth. I attached our proposed schema and the marketplace checklist. Deadline from Nimbus legal/marketplace: Nov 30 for the listing request to move to "in review".

Attached: nimbus_draft_marketplace_requirements.pdf, proposed_metering_schema.json

Can you confirm who I should work with at Redwood (product & eng) and whether you can support the exception request to allow a usage-based offering while we implement the metering endpoint?

Appreciate it — will jump on a call if that helps.

— Sanjay
Sanjay Kumar
Head of Partnerships | NimbusCloud

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Kumar <sanjay@nimbuscloud.io>
Cc: Elena Morozova <elena@nimbuscloud.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace listing — usage-based SKU & integration checklist

Sanjay — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. Looping in Karthik (sales lead) and Laura (partnerships ops) to align on commercial exceptions and launch checklist.

High level: Redwood supports metered partners in Dedicated/Private deployments today and we have patterns for reporting consumption to marketplace partners. That said, getting an exception to the public marketplace SKU rules will need legal + product sign-off and a short technical plan from Eng.

Karthik/Laura — can you confirm whether sales/legal can approve an "usage-exempt" public SKU for Nimbus while we implement metering? Also, please add Product and Eng owners if we need to scope a small adapter work item.

Sanjay — proposed next steps: (1) internal triage (sales/legal/product/eng) this week, (2) agree go/no-go on exception by Nov 20, (3) if go, ship a lightweight metering adapter by Nov 30 to meet Nimbus deadline. Does that sequencing work for you?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace listing — usage-based SKU & integration checklist

Thanks Vanessa — quick read and a couple of notes from the GTM side:

- Commercial: Sales/legal can approve an exception only if the partner signs a short SOW and accepts Redwood-managed metering SLA terms. Laura, can you draft an SOW stub (2–3 bullets) we can send to Nimbus?
- Product: Grace, need your take on whether we can support an "off-band" metering model for public listings and what constraints we should document publicly.
- Eng: Dev, can you estimate effort to add a lightweight metering adapter that validates events and forwards to our internal billing pipeline? If we can do a small adapter (1–2 devs, 2 sprints), we can meet Nov 30. If it's larger, we need to push the listing date.

Sanjay (external) — presuming Nimbus will sign the SOW and accept logging/audit requirements. If so, we'll try the adapter approach. Vanessa: please set expectations with Nimbus that final sign-off depends on legal review.

Karthik
VP, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace listing — usage-based SKU & integration checklist

Quick technical note after a 1:1 with Grace: we can ship a "metering-adapter" service that exposes POST /v1/metering-events and validates the schema you attached. Two implementation options: 

A) Lightweight adapter (recommended): stateless adaptor that accepts Nimbus events, validates JWT (Nimbus signs), normalizes events to our internal billing proto, and POSTs to our billing ingestion endpoint. Estimated: 2 devs, 3 weeks (inclusive of basic tests). Includes security review but no schema migration.

B) Full integration: update core billing ingestion to natively accept partner events with stronger guarantees (idempotency, dedupe). Estimated: 6+ weeks, larger QA.

We do have an internal dependency: the billing team needs a small change to accept the normalized payload format (minor). I'll attach a short design doc with the adapter sketch. If we go with A, we can realistically hit Nov 30 if SOW/legal sign by Nov 20.

Attachments: metering_adapter_design.md

Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Inference Platform | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: NimbusCloud marketplace listing — next steps & action items

Sanjay / Elena — quick status update and next steps from Redwood's side after our internal triage: 

Summary: Redwood can support a usage-based listing for Nimbus provided we put a short SOW in place and ship the lightweight metering-adapter (option A). We will seek a limited exception with Marketplace for an "off-band" metering flow tied to an "usage-exempt" SKU. Legal has prelim sign-off pending SOW. Engineering confirms a 3-week delivery if SOW is approved by Nov 20.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Nimbus: Confirm acceptance of Redwood SOW stub (Laura to send) and sign by Nov 20 — owner: Sanjay (Nimbus)
- Redwood Legal/Finance: review & sign SOW — owner: Laura Bennett — due Nov 20
- Engineering: implement metering-adapter (Dev/infra) — owner: Dev Patel — target complete Nov 30
- Product: publish integration notes & public listing caveat (Grace) — due Nov 30
- Vanessa/Karthik: escalate to Marketplace contact if we need a soft exception during review — due Nov 23

Sanjay — Laura will send the SOW stub in the next email. Once SOW is signed, Dev will kick off the adapter work and we’ll share a short QA plan. If any of the deadlines are problematic on your side, please flag immediately.
